Trump Urges Ukraine to Halt Strikes on Russian Energy Targets

Former U.S. President Donald Trump has called on Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to stop attacking Russian energy targets. Trump stated that these attacks are causing a global diesel fuel shortage and spiking prices. He suggested that Ukraine should cease these specific strikes, implying it would alleviate the price issue. The request comes amid ongoing conflict and Ukraine's strategy to pressure Moscow.
